vocabulary.definition: relating to Soli, an ancient city in Cilicia (modern-day Turkey)
vocabulary.example: The solician pirates captured Julius Caesar in the Aegean Sea.

vocabulary.definition: relating to the Aegean Sea, an arm of the Mediterranean Sea between Greece and Turkey
vocabulary.example: Julius Caesar was held by pirates in the Aegean Sea for 38 days.

vocabulary.definition: a sum of money or other payment demanded or paid for the release of a prisoner
vocabulary.example: Julius Caesar was released by the pirates after a ransom was paid.

vocabulary.definition: to gather together or bring together into one place or group
vocabulary.example: After his release, Julius Caesar assembles a private military fleet.

vocabulary.definition: the action of inflicting hurt or harm on someone for an injury or wrong suffered at their hands
vocabulary.example: Julius Caesar takes revenge by capturing and crucifying his captors.

vocabulary.definition: putting to death by nailing or binding someone to a cross
vocabulary.example: Julius Caesar retaliated by capturing and crucifying his enemies.
